numerical_method: RK4 on the N-link planar Lagrangian equations with the muscle drive held over each step; batched seeds with common random numbers; first-order activation dynamics; digests over 6 significant digits

design.label_rule: BH q < 0.05 over all 98 principle x organization tests and |d| >= 0.8
design.reading: with 12 paired seeds an effect of about 0.81 (standardised, paired) is detectable with 80% power at the 0.05 level; smaller true effects are expected to be missed, so 'no detectable effect' is not 'no effect'

organizations.correction_quality: correction quality (peak COM deviation after a push, lower is better)
organizations.fatigue_cost: fatigue / energy cost (energy used, lower is better)
organizations.posture_stability: posture stability (trunk sway, lower is better)
organizations.precision: precision (COM error in the last second, lower is better)
organizations.recovery_time: recovery time after a push (lower is better)
organizations.turn_speed: direction-change speed (settling time after the turn, lower is better)

anti-collapse-posture.definition: when a lean exceeds 0.55 of the base, catches it with a strong correction that costs energy
anti-collapse-posture.operationalization: strong ankle drive when the sensed COM offset exceeds 55 % of the toe-side base of support

axis-maintenance.definition: ignites when the body axis deviates by more than 0.02; adds a lean correction proportional to the axis to every segment; costs energy
axis-maintenance.operationalization: ankle and hip drive proportional to the sensed trunk tilt when it exceeds 0.02 rad

breathing-synchronization.definition: a breath cycle modulates segment tension; on the exhale phase a lean beyond 0.04 is released
breathing-synchronization.ignition: exhale phase and |sensed trunk tilt| > 0.04 rad
breathing-synchronization.operationalization: breath-phase modulation of co-contraction; trunk release drive during exhalation when |tilt| > 0.04 rad

endpoint-removal.definition: disables the endpoint-driven wind-up of a step and replaces it by a whole-body movement
endpoint-removal.operationalization: the movement strategy becomes whole-body (no anticipatory counter-lean before the cue response)

fingertip-tension.definition: holds a fingertip tension of at least 0.4 and couples it to the lower-abdominal tension
fingertip-tension.ignition: distal tension < 0.4 on the slow clock
fingertip-tension.operationalization: a distal-tension state kept at or above 0.4 that adds co-contraction

long-duration-sedimentation.definition: a slow clock deposits a retained increment that raises coupling gain and tension
long-duration-sedimentation.operationalization: a sediment state grows on an accelerated slow clock (one unit per 2 s, for demonstration) and adds co-contraction

low-noise-movement.definition: ignites when an external push is registered; damps the push and reduces lean
low-noise-movement.operationalization: halves the motor noise and adds joint damping drive while the sensed head rate exceeds 0.05 rad/s

lower-abdominal-continuity.definition: maintains a lower-abdominal tension of at least 0.6, coupled to the tension of every segment; tonic, slow, costs energy
lower-abdominal-continuity.ignition: core tension < 0.6 on the slow clock
lower-abdominal-continuity.operationalization: a core-tension state kept at or above 0.6 on a slow clock; it adds co-contraction to knee, hip, neck and ankle

minimal-approach-distance.alias: upward abdominal organization / minimum-distance action (alias mapping uncertain)
minimal-approach-distance.definition: shortens the approach: reduces the movement velocity above a limit
minimal-approach-distance.ignition: sensed COM velocity > 0.05 m/s towards the target
minimal-approach-distance.operationalization: braking drive on the ankle when the sensed COM velocity towards the target exceeds 0.05 m/s

narrow-step-balance.definition: the base of support is narrower (0.7 of its usual width)
narrow-step-balance.operationalization: the base of support (toe and heel lengths) is 0.7 of nominal

slow-movement.operationalization: the reference ramp is 1.8 times slower

tensegrity.definition: tension is distributed over the segments: each segment's tension relaxes towards the mean
tensegrity.operationalization: co-contraction across joints is partly equalised (50 % towards the mean)

whole-skin-sensing.definition: senses lean over the whole surface with fine resolution and corrects locally when a segment's signal exceeds a threshold
whole-skin-sensing.operationalization: per-joint local correction from the sensed joint angle when it exceeds 0.03 rad (uses the tactile channel's noise)

zero-run-up-transition.definition: starts the transition without any run-up when the cue arrives
zero-run-up-transition.operationalization: whole-body strategy with a 20 % faster reference ramp

results.reading: Principles are experimental conditions (planar translations of ziran-xeno-simulator: src/domains/body.ts (XENO14, bundle()); embodied/xeno14/principles.py); no sign of effect was assumed. Positive, negative and null results are all listed.
